batting.dismissal: c M Vijay b WD Parnell

batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b Imran Tahir

batting.dismissal: st AP Tare b S Gopal

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b M de Lange

balls.text: Mumbai's innings ends in shambles. Parnell bounces Bumrah, who tries to pull and is beaten. The square leg umpire begins to call the ball wide for height, but Gopal calls Bumrah through to try and get on strike by stealing a bye. Karthik hits the stumps and Gopal is not even in the frame
short of a length and straight, Bumrah slogs across the line and misses
banged in short and Bumrah is late on the hook and beaten
driven to long on for a single

it's all happening out there! Gopal charges down the pitch and slogs, the ball flies off the outside edge but falls short of Unadkat at short third man. The ball deflects off Unadkat towards Tiwary at point. The batsmen hesitate and the throw comes to the keeper quickly. Ojha is well short
punched off the back foot to cover for a quick single
swatted off the back foot to deep midwicket
played off the back foot towards the bowler, Tahir fumbles and concedes a single

De Lange looks unhappy with the decision to give him out caught behind. He tried to reverse sweep a full ball outside off stump - how's that for shot selection in this position? - and missed. Not sure if he edged it into Karthik's gloves because the sound seemed to come from the bat hitting the ground. There might have been some glove on it
Gopal steps out of his crease and hits the ball towards long-on, gets to the fielder on the bounce
full and straight, Gopal stays steady in his crease and flicks the ball through midwicket
short and wide outside off stump, poor delivery, Gopal stays back and cuts the ball superbly between the fielders at point and gully
Gopal moves back and across towards the off side to drive to point
a full toss outside off stump, the batsman opens the face a little and the ball goes off the thick outside edge to beat the keeper on his right
Mumbai are giving Delhi catching practice. Harbhajan simply lofts a length ball through the line, hitting it straight to Vijay at long-off. This is some exceptionally ordinary batting
good length on middle and off, stays in his crease and dabs in front of point for a single
bowled full and straight, driven from middle stump through cover
nudged off the front foot through point for a single, they think about the second but decide against it
pushed towards long on for a single

what on earth are Mumbai doing? Tare moves forward, gets down on one knee and slog sweeps the ball straight to Kedar Jadhav at deep midwicket. Jadhav came forward and got down on his knees to take the catch. It was the googly that did Tare in
that's too short this time, Tare moves back in a flash and cuts the ball firmly, placing it well enough to beat the fielder's dive on the boundary
Tahir fires it in flat and on a good length outside off, Tare is beaten on the cut
glanced off the pads towards short fine leg
Harbhajan gets on the front foot and nurdles the ball towards point

Rayudu steps out and lofts the ball straight to M Vijay at long-off. Vijay did not have to move at all and he took it really casually. Rayudu had not got to the pitch of the ball and ended up slicing it
nudged on the leg side, towards midwicket for a single
that pitched on middle and spun across the right-hander, Tare defended it it on the back foot, he was squared up a bit
punched from the crease through extra cover for a single
Tare's started in high gear! This ball is full and outside off, and Tare square drives it past point for successive boundaries
that's a sensational drive, the ball was full outside off, Tare moves forward and drives on the up through cover, perfectly timed and placed

caught behind! Unadkat has jolted this innings out of the blue. Pollard cannot believe he has been given out, and I am not sure why he seems confused. Unadkat bowled full, in the blockhole outside off stump, Pollard tried to squeeze it out on the off side but his bat hit the ground first and then the ball went off the outside edge to the keeper
good length around off stump, Rayudu stays in his crease, drops the ball close on the off side and runs
bowled him! A poor choice of shot from Rohit. He backed away outside leg to cut a fuller ball that was following him and cramping him for room. He missed, and leg stump took a hit
he bangs it in short and the ball disappears, Rohit met it on the front foot and pulled hard into the gap on the midwicket boundary
turned off the pads through midwicket
Pollard steps out again but has to adjust and defend after Nadeem fired the ball flat into the right-hander
driven to the fielder on the extra cover boundary
that's a quicker ball angling into the right-hander, worked off the back foot towards long on
driven to long off for another single
Pollard steps out but isn't to the pitch of the ball against the left-arm spinner from round the wicket, pushed off the pads through midwicket
nudged off the pads on the back foot towards square leg
Pollard has a mighty swing at a flat, faster and wide ball outside off, he was beaten by a long way. Pollard wanted to launch it over cover
Pollard doesn't waste any time! He simply lofts a full ball on the front foot far over the straight boundary. Sweet contact
full toss on the pads, nearly outside leg, flicked to deep midwicket
tries to drive a fuller ball without much footwork and is beaten
Rohit stays back and flicks the ball towards cow corner and his placement was almost perfect, the fielder had to dive to save the boundary

whoa. Why did they run for that? back of a length, Rohit waits, opens his face, and dabs it to Jadhav at point. He throws to the keeper's end, and DK has disturbed the stumps with Hussey short of the crease. The bails come off fully with his bat just short, almost on the line
full toss, driven to wide long-off
shortish ball, Rohit backs away and chips it down to wide long-off. Didn't really get hold of it
sweet. down the pitch, and he doesn't get to the pitch, bit he's hit it on the up to the left of a diving cover
Hussey comes down the pitch and yorks himself somewhat, digs the ball out to long-off
full and on the stumps, Rohit leans forward and works it to long-on
wide outside off again, he cuts it to the man at deep point
another low full toss, Rohit drives to the man at cover
a full toss on the pads, Rohit did not hit it too hard, just drove it firmly along the ground towards cow corner
short, wide and rubbish. Rohit reaches out for it again and cuts the ball hard through point, no protection in the deep
bowled flat and wide outside off stump, Rohit reaches for it and opens the face, dabbing it between the keeper and short third man for another boudnary
Hussey has mis-timed one! He steps out and slogs, he was probably looking for wide long-on but the ball went along the ground through midwicket
nudged off the back foot on the leg side for a single that brings up Mumbai's 100, in ten over.
driven firmly, but straight to cover
that's the googly and Hussey has sent it flat over extra cover for six to bring up his fifty. He got to the pitch of it on the front foot, read the delivery and drove it perfectly
pushed off the front foot to long on for another single
bowled full around off stump, Hussey stays in his crease and drives the ball through cover
Rohit leans forward and drives the tossed up ball to long off
Hussey tries to drive through the off side but gets an inside edge on to the pad
Hussey tries to sweep but does not make proper contact
a full ball around off stump, driven to long off for a single
worked from outside off stump through the leg side for a single
Rohit stepped out of his crease and aimed for deep midwicket, the ball went off the leading edge to long-on
defended back to the bowler on the front foot

caught in the deep this time! Simmons tries to blast over the cover boundary but mis-times it, he ends up slicing it in the air and Parnell comes running in from the deep and take s a well-judged catch on the move. Tahir's celebrations are characteristically exuberant
the fuller one and on a straighter line but it makes no difference, Simmons drills it down the ground and beats the fielder at long-on
cut hard through point again, there's just too much width from Tahir, there's a fielder in the deep this time
width offered outside off and though the length is fuller Simmons manages to play a superb square drive to the point boundary
that's a poor call for wide I'm afraid, Simmons had backed away so far outside leg and to counter that Tahir fired the ball wide outside off, that was inside the wide line
he's pitched it too short and there's enough room outside off for Simmons to go back and lash the ball through point with a fearsome cut
bowled flat and straight, Hussey goes back and clips the ball through square leg
Hussey leans forward and drives to long-on for one more
that's flat and short, luckily for Duminy, Simmons cut it straight to the fielder at short third man
a full ball on off stump, Hussey drives to deep extra cover
paddled behind square for a single
he's mis-timed this, the slog across the line aimed for the stands beyond midwicket, the ball falls short of the fielders in the deep
pushed off the back foot into the gap beyond extra cover, Hussey hustles the second
fired down leg side, Simmons paddles straight to short fine leg and Hussey calls him through, Simmons has to run really hard to make it but the throw is poor
flat and on leg stump, Hussey turns the ball off his pads through square leg
a quicker one skids into the right-hander, Simmons manages to push it towards square leg
nudged towards midwicket for a single
you'll love this too! Hussey charges the spinner, gets to the pitch of the ball, and plays a flowing lofted drive, hitting through the line and sending the ball soaring over the straight boundary
fires it down leg side, the ball brushes Simmons' pad and runs down to fine leg
how can you bowl that length with fine leg in the circle? Short and down leg side. Hussey swings around and pulls to the long leg boundary
shot! Mumbai bring up 50 in quick time. Hussey charges down the pitch and then cuts a length ball fiercely through point
Simmons steps out of his crease but has to adjust because Kaul shortens his length and cramps him for room
Hussey dives at the bowler's end to make his crease; he had set off for a single after Simmons played the ball to square leg
Delhi are bleeding here, Simmons opens the face to steer a length ball past the man at point, there's no one in the deep and this outfield is fast

a huge appeal for lbw after Simmons misses the pull, the length was not short enough and the ball skidded through and hit the back thigh. The impact was too high. What's worse for Delhi is that the ball went off the thigh to the third man boundary
banged in short and down leg side, Simmons advances and tries to pull but misses, that's a big wide

a close call at the bowler's end! Simmons would have been gone with a direct hit. He pushed the ball into the covers and ran though the fielder got to the ball really quickly. The under-arm throw missed at the non-striker's end though
a fuller length on off and middle, Hussey flicks through midwicket
just not that short really but Unadkat's pace is such that Hussey has enough time to swivel and pull to the square leg boundary
Simmons plays the ball towards point and sets off for a single
a better length, pitching around off and angling into the left-hander, Hussey tries to glance but misses and is hit on the pad
that's too short, Hussey's bread and butter, he picks it up from around off and pulls to the midwicket boundary
Simmons backs away outside leg stump and slugs a short of a length ball towards deep midwicket, he didn't time it so the ball plugs in the outfield
Simmons gets on to the front foot, moves slightly towards the off, and slogs a short ball over midwicket for four
in the blockhole once again, played back to the bowler
width outside off stump and Hussey cuts off the back foot to third man
turned off the pads to square leg
Hussey steps down the pitch and lofts a slower ball through the line, chipping it back over the bowler's head for four
picks off a single by pushing the ball towards midwicket
a length ball on a wicket to wicket line, played from the crease towards midwicket
pushed from the crease into the leg side for a single
that's a poor ball, full length and down leg side, all Hussey needed to do was get enough bat on it to beat the fielder at short fine leg, well executed
a full ball on the pads, this time Hussey makes good contact with the flick but places it to the fielder at midwicket
a full ball on leg stump, Hussey tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pad
stays in his crease and opens the face to steer to third man
pushed to mid-on for a single, direct hit at the striker's end but Simmons is well home
shot, Hussey gets going with a cracking drive, using the width on offer outside off stump to drive off the front foot through cover
strays on to the pads this time on a full length, Simmons is well balanced as he glances towards long leg
nearly in the blockhole once again, clipped off the pads towards mid-on
in the blockhole first up from over the wicket, Simmons stays in his crease and keeps it out
hit down the ground to long off for a single, exceptional execution of blockhole-bowling by Bumrah ... Mumbai take the game by 15 runs and are surging up the table.
a blockhole delivery speared into the pads, Jadhav can't make contact
backs away outside leg and throws his bat at it, carving the ball over the fielder at short third man
another blockhole delivery, excellent death bowling, Duminy can't get under it and so he drives it to long off
in the blockhole once again, nothing much a batsman can do with that, Jadhav hits it through midwicket
full and straight, Duminy makes room and hits it along the ground to long-off
in the blockhole once again, Jadhav swings across the line and manages to play it through square, they come back for the second but Marchant has completed a terrific over and all but killed the game
in the blockhole outside off stump, Jadhav is beaten
Duminy slogs across the line but gets a thick inside edge behind square
he's skied this, it's swirling in the evening sky and when the ball comes down Michael Hussey is right under it ... Tiwary had cleared his front foot to slog and ended up slicing the good length ball
in the blockhole on leg stump, Duminy digs it out and plays it through square leg, just the single
short ball and Tiwary pulls to deep square leg ...
that's a high full toss, that's a no-ball, and Duminy's pulled it straight to Hussey at deep midwicket, the catch has been taken but Hussey throws it back quickly
superb shot! He gets under a half-volley and plays the lofted drive to the extra cover boundary, one-bounce four
in the blockhole outside off stump, he can't do much but dig it out to the bowler
a really low full toss, Duminy drives to long on for a single
he's slaughtered this, he gets down low and slog sweeps the seamer far over the midwicket boundary. Duminy cleared his front leg to create hitting space
full and straight, driven to long on for a single
the bouncer outside off stump, Tiwary slogs in vain, he was in no position to play that shot
that's a rubbish full toss and Duminy pulls it over the deep midwicket boundary. Harbhajan was furious with himself after that ball, lots of unprintable material
Tiwary moves back and swats the ball from outside off over the in-field at midwicket
short ball and he's pulled it off the back foot to deep midwicket
pushed close on the off side
Rayudu sprints to his right on the deep midwicket boundary and leaps to try and catch a pull from Tiwary, he gets a hand on it but then he falls to the ground and the ball goes over the boundary
bowled flat and straight, Duminy has no room to work with and he cuts through point
bowled full and outside off, Duminy drives to long off for a single
Tiwary steps out and dabs the ball into the covers for a single
a full toss but Duminy only drives it to long-on for a single
Duminy's not waiting anymore. He gets down on one knee and blitzes the ball over cow corner with a powerful slog sweep
goes on the back foot and pulls to cow corner
Duminy steps out of the crease but is not to the pitch of the ball, he nudges on the leg side
swung away to deep midwicket on the front foot, he did not time that well
Tare appeals again for a caught behind but no one else does, Duminy tried to pull once again but was beaten outside off
banged in short and beats Duminy on the back-foot pull, Duminy swung too early
once again they tap it straight to the fielder at short third man and run, Pollard is not happy
dabbed off the back foot straight to short third man for a single
steered to short third man and they steal a single
pushed on the back foot towards cover
goes back and across in his crease and works the ball through square
that's pitched outside leg stump and spinning further away down leg side
goes back into his crease and pushes the ball towards long-on
steps out again but defends to the bowler because he is beaten in the flight
defended on the off side
Tiwary leaps out of his crease, lunges for the ball because he isn't to the pitch of it, but makes great connection with the slog sweep to clear the midwicket boundary
a full toss on the pads, Tiwary misses the glance and is hit on the pad for leg byes behind square leg
full and straight, driven to long on for a single
short of a length outside off stump, Tiwary bunts it behind point for a single
a full toss on the pads, Tiwary flicks and places it into the gap on the square leg boundary
another extravagant appeal from Tare as the slower ball from de Lange strays down leg side, that was close to nothing, huge wide
a big appeal from the keeper Tare as the ball slants down leg side and the batsman tries to glance, might have brushed the body
Duminy waits for the length ball as it angles across him from over the wicket and opens the face to steer to third man
a fuller length on middle and leg, Duminy stays back and nudges off his pads behind square
that's too short from Gopal and Duminy goes back into his crease and pulls the ball high and far over deep midwicket
played to backward point for a quick single
steps out of his crease to a flighted ball, gets to the pitch of it, and lofts over the bowler's head between long off and long on
Duminy attempts the big slog sweep but mis-times it through square leg
driven back towards the bowler, that was in the air for a bit but fell short
finally he gets the execution right, Tiwary gets down on one knee and paddles the ball fine past the keeper, times it well too
he plays the paddle sweep this time, and Rohit from first slip runs after the ball
now Tiwary tries to reverse sweep and was nearly bowled after he was beaten close to leg stump
Tiwary steps out but isn't to the pitch of the ball, ends up playing it towards the non-striker
Tiwary moves forward and across to nudge on the leg side
Duminy gets on to the front foot, gets down on one knee, and sweeps behind square
a full ball swinging away from Duminy, who pushes towards mid off and runs
full and straight, nearly in the blockhole, Duminy keeps it out

When a tall fast bowler is delivering at 140 kph plus, moving across your stumps towards the off and exposing all of them while trying to scoop is probably not the best choice of shot. Karthik tried it and his middle and leg stumps took a hit
good length around off stump, pushed off the front foot through cover
short ball and Karthik pulls to deep midwicket
144.5 kph, short of a length and at Karthik's body, he defends with a straight bat on the back foot
nudged off the front foot to midwicket
KP's been bowled while trying to switch-hit! Harbhajan slowed it up and bowled straight. KP switched and swung too early, the ball dipped on him beat the bat and hit the stumps
KP makes room and tries to hit the ball off the back foot through cover but can't find the gap
moves across his crease and nudges through midwicket
Karthik tries to play the reverse paddle-sweep with the back of his bat but makes no contact
KP cuts as the ball slides across him and he gets a thick outside edge to short third man, he runs a risky single too
Karthik steps out of his crease but then defends because he is not to the pitch of the legbreak
short ball, bowled flat outside off, KP cuts it as it begins to break away from him, towards deep point
this time he connects with the slog sweep, but there is a fielder at deep midwicket
Karthik attempts a big slog sweep but is beaten outside off stump
pushed from the crease towards point
backs away outside leg and drives off the back foot through cover
nudged off the pads towards square leg
backs away outside leg to cut but can't beat the fielder at short third man
KP waits for the full ball outside off stump, makes room and plays the lofted drive into the gap on the extra cover boundary
defended from the crease towards midwicket
KP is beaten outside leg stump while playing the reverse sweep

tossed up outside off stump, KP lunges on the front foot and drives hard through extra cover, using his long reach. Hussey is the boundary rider and his throw to the bowler is good, Karthik is home though
Karthik moves back to a short ball and ends up pulling it past the fielder at mid-on, I think he wanted to hit that through midwicket but he'll get four anyway
pitched on a great length around off stump, Karthik has to come forward and defend
punched to mid-off, this was timed better
driven on the front foot to mid-on, not timed well

Vijay's been stumped! A nothing shot from him. He got out of his crease but was no where near the pitch of the ball. It dipped on him, and he swung in desperation as the ball spun away and beat the outside edge. Tare had the bails off in a flash with Vijay's back foot out of the crease
defended on the front foot back to the bowler
goes back and across to work the ball through midwicket
Vijay steps out and chips over the bowler's head
nudged behind square for a single
edged! But the ball flies fast and wide of Hussey at slip! KP backed away to make room and cut hard, the edge was a difficult one to take
Vijay goes back into his crease and works the ball through midwicket
pushed off the front foot to mid-on
a fast full toss on leg stump, KP leans across in his crease and works it to long on
another slower ball wide outside off stump, KP drove away from his body on the front foot but played the shot way too early and was beaten
in the blockhole outside off stump, KP tries to squeeze it out behind point but is beaten
tries to whip it on the leg side but misses and is hit on the pad

Dropped, by de Lange, but the chance was a really tough one. KP lofted a slower ball down the ground but mis-timed it. He hit it really high and de Lange had to run a long way back from mid-on, he got finger tips on it
a length ball outside off stump, and it has disappeared! KP meets it on the front foot and lofts on the up, though the line. Cleared long-off comfortably
blocked on the front foot on the off side
that's the one that slides on with the arm, KP stays in his crease and defends watchfully on the leg side

KP's been beaten and the bails are off! Was he out of his crease? Ojha flighted the ball nicely into the right-hander and spun it away from KP, beating the booming drive. KP dragged his back foot out but slid it back in time before the stumps were broken
KP plays the first ball from the left-arm spinner on the front foot and with a straight bat
Vijay leans across and flicks with the angle into him through square leg
defended on the back foot
a half-volley on the pads, too easy for KP, he picks it up lofts over midwicket for successive boundaries
that's short of a length and KP's hands are so quick, he gets into position in a flash and plays a short-arm pull to the backward square leg boundary
good length outside off stump, Vijay stays back and opens the face of his bat to steer the ball to third man
KP stays in his crease and dabs the good length ball to midwicket and sets off for a quick single
a better line and length, around off stump, driven on the up to mid-off
that's too full and too far on leg stump, KP leans across in his crease and glances to the fine-leg boundary
Hussey dives to his left at cover and brings down a speeding ball, KP had driven it hard off the front foot, three runs saved
a fuller length closer to off stump, KP gets on to the front foot and plays to cover
KP gets a freebie first up, it's short and really wide, KP uses his long reach and cuts the ball off the front foot through point
speared into the pads from wide of the crease, Vijay misses out while trying to whip it behind square, the ball goes off his pad
a full ball around off stump, Vijay moves forward and across and drives to cover
slants into the pads with his first delivery, nudged from the crease through square leg
